fusion.normalization_source: Calibration genuine-distance medians with fixed scale 1 if the median is zero.

calibration.selection: Minimum calibration balanced error; ties prefer lower FMR, then lower threshold.

evaluation_protocol: Regularized LDA settings and fusion weights were selected using calibration rows only. Metric fitting uses enrollment descriptors only; raw enrollment median templates are preserved. Thresholds and normalization scales are frozen before the historical exploratory test split is scored. That enrolled-user image split has unknown capture sessions and potentially correlated frames and pairs; it is not a fresh untouched holdout, and cross-session or webcam performance remains unverified.
